key_impacts: Damage to Fukushima Daiichi Units 1–4 requiring mid- and long-term decommissioning
Large volumes of ALPS-treated water stored on-site (about 1,100,000 m3 as of October 2018), with planned tank capacity of 1.37 million m3 expected to be reached within three to four years

Ongoing generation of contaminated water, reduced from approximately 490 m3/day (FY2015 average) to approximately 200 m3/day (first half FY2018) through countermeasures including subdrain repair and the frozen soil wall
Presence of fuel debris in Units 1–3 requiring investigation, sampling, and development of retrieval methods
Spent fuel remains in reactor building pools; removal preparations are ongoing for Units 3, 1, and 2
missing_information: Extent of radioactive release and environmental contamination
Exact affected administrative areas beyond the plant
